Officers searched properties in the Waterfront Park and Colonsay View areas of the city on Wednesday.
Detectives said three firearms, ammunition and a five-figure sum of money were recovered.
A 26-year-old man who was arrested and charged appeared at Edinburgh Sheriff Court on Thursday.
examples.reference: A man has appeared in court after firearms, ammunition and cash were seized by police in Edinburgh.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 3段落の捜索・押収・出廷が要約に対応。

examples.input:
The 48-year-old former Arsenal goalkeeper played for the Royals for four years.
He was appointed youth academy director in 2000 and has been director of football since 2003.
A West Brom statement said: "He played a key role in the Championship club twice winning promotion to the Premier League in 2006 and 2012."
examples.reference: West Brom have appointed Nicky Hammond as technical director, ending his 20-year association with Reading.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 任命された人名/任命そのものは元documentにもない。p12で既に説明されている。

examples.input:
The bird's head and wings became stuck in the wire fence in Bethesda while it was chasing a wood pigeon.
RSPCA Inspector Mike Pugh, who freed the animal, said: "The buzzard was feisty, but luckily, had not had much feather damage.
"I released the bird back to the wild where he belongs straight away."
examples.reference: A buzzard has been rescued after becoming trapped between fencing and a wall in Gwynedd.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 救助/放鳥とノスリは本文にある。Gwynedd/壁は元要約側の追加情報。

examples.reference: These roads in Northern Ireland are closed due to poor weather conditions as of Friday 15 January.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 配布document自体が道路名6行。天候/日付は元要約側だけにあり、表示省略ではない。

examples.input:
Penglais Farm will have a total of 1,000 rooms, but only 700 will be ready this month to welcome students.
The university said developer Balfour Beatty confirmed the remaining 300 rooms will be ready during the 2015-16 academic year.
Balfour Beatty has been asked to comment.
The unfinished rooms have not been let to students.
examples.reference: Hundreds of rooms at a £45m student halls development at Aberystwyth University will not be ready for the new term.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 1000室/700室完成/300室未完成の対応が読める。費用/大学名は元要約側の追加。

examples.input:
Sayes Court will double in size and provide an additional 210 places by September 2015.
Surrey County Council said it needs to "bridge a Â£215m funding gap" for 13,000 places, blaming an "unprecedented demand" on its services.
It said nearby Esher School is also being completely rebuilt to boost capacity by 210 places.
examples.reference: An artist's impression of how an expanded primary school in Addlestone will look has been unveiled.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 定員増の本文3段落すべてあり、完成予想図公開は元要約側のみ。

examples.input:
Polling booths opened at 07:00 BST in the area's 15 constituencies, with results expected to be declared after midnight.
Votes will be counted after the polls close at 22:00 BST.
For the latest news from all the counts on Merseyside, go to our election live service or check the results on your constituency profile page.
examples.reference: People are voting across Merseyside in the general and local council elections.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 投票開始/終了/開票/地域が全3段落で読める。

examples.input:
Watson, 22, was seeded eighth in the tournament but lost 7-5 6-2 to the world number 101 in Seoul.
The British number one, ranked 46 in the world, converted just one of seven break points in the first set and the American dominated the second set.
Watson's early departure comes less than a month after her first-round defeat in straight sets at the US Open.
examples.reference: Britain's Heather Watson has been knocked out of the first round of the Korea Open by qualifier Nicole Gibbs.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 試合スコア/敗退が読める。相手フルネームは元要約側の追加。

examples.input:
6 December 2014 Last updated at 09:15 GMT
The Grammy Awards is one of the most prestigious music ceremony's in the world.
Sam Smith, who topped the BBC's Sound of 2014 in January, has six nominations including best new artist.
His single Stay With Me is also up for best pop performance and record of the year.
examples.reference: British artists have scooped several nominations for the 2015 Grammys.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 日時/賞の説明/Sam Smithの複数候補が読める。

examples.input:
Areas in Counties Londonderry, Antrim and Down were affected.
A spokesperson for Northern Ireland Electricity said was an equipment fault was detected at 21.40 BST.
All properties have had power restored had their power restored by 22.14 BST.
examples.reference: Several thousand customers were left without electricity for a time on Wednesday night.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 故障の検出と復旧時刻が読める。数千世帯/水曜は元要約側の追加。

examples.input:
Two were picked up by a coastguard helicopter high up on the 3,196ft (974 metre) Munro.
Lomond Mountain Rescue Team located two others on the lower slopes.
Mountain weather forecasters were predicting winds of up to 80mph with frequent snow showers at summit level in western Scotland for Wednesday.
examples.reference: Four hillwalkers who got into difficulties during severe weather on Ben Lomond have been rescued.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 2人＋別2人と悪天候予報が読める。

examples.input:
The 33-year-old has featured only twice for the Foxes this term, having signed a new one-year deal with the Premier League newcomers in the summer.
Former Blackpool forward Taylor-Fletcher scored three goals in 23 games for his parent club last season.
He joined the 13th-placed Owls prior to Saturday's Championship game against Norwich City.
examples.reference: Leicester City striker Gary Taylor-Fletcher has joined Sheffield Wednesday on an initial month-long loan.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 出場機会/得点/新クラブ加入が読める。期間は元要約側の追加。

examples.input:
3 February 2016 Last updated at 08:07 GMT
The British astronaut has been up there for six weeks, but took time out to speak to children and share some experiments.
Leah went to meet some of kids lucky enough to be able to talk direct to the astronaut...
examples.reference: Children across Britain linked up with Tim Peake on the International Space Station yesterday for a big question and answer session.
examples.correspondence_assessment: 日時/宇宙飛行士と児童の交流が読める。Tim Peake/ISSは元要約側の追加。

conclusion: 全13例のdocument/summary全文を保持しており、表示拡張不要。元データにない事実をBBC現行記事から追加して固定問題を変えない。
